coverage.heading: Header and election applicability
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Complete header, July 7 dated title, explicit 23J programme introduction and surrounding municipal navigation read. The original article defines these national election proposals; the linked municipal 28M programme is separate.

coverage.heading: 1. Quiero infraestructuras
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Suburban/regional rail and Motril freight connections, specified Loja/Moreda/Guadix-Baza-Lorca projects, airport/metro, logistics port, technical/environmental coastal protection, Rules irrigation/wastewater, rural public transport/broadband, conditional Sierra Nevada sport expansion and heritage tram. Free fares, nationwide flight prohibition and quantified rural fare entitlements are unsupported. Publisher cost/tourism forecasts are not independently verified.

coverage.heading: 2. Quiero sostenibilidad
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Spending and metropolitan administration consolidation; traditional agriculture with no macrofarms; studies/limits for very large renewable parks; ecosystem/tourism preservation; reduced urban traffic/intermodal transport; accessible administration without requiring everyone to use Internet; pension minimum including alternative mutualists; youth employment; staffing and broad housing/energy/eldercare claims. No specific inflation index, universal utility cutoff ban, rent cap or every farm prohibition follows.

coverage.heading: 3. Quiero recuperación institucional
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Granada management of Alhambra/Cetursa/science park; recover specified institutions; maintain the public health school and superior court seat; regional emergency academy branch. Repeal of the autonomous constitutional system and creation of other ministries are unsupported.

coverage.heading: 4. Quiero ciencia, cultura y deporte
coverage.authoredAnalysis: AESIA relocation to Granada and IFMIF-DONES support, expanded health technology park, provincial heritage institute/archaeological defence network, intangible culture/gastronomy/music/museums/libraries and sustainable sport events. The projected 3000 jobs are a party argument, not a proven consequence. No school religion rule, equal media minutes or existing research open access proposition is established.

coverage.heading: Closing and external assets

Cover refers to a 20-reasons item, whose separate full original remains unresolved; the article is not proof of that booklet completeness.
